purpose: Role of components, honest amortization, scalability and robustness for the current authenticated group cost-change certificate.

hardware.storage_revision: 500GB was an unmeasured comfort allowance, not a requirement. Existing case directories are about1.5–2.4GiB, dominated by cached proving keys and constraint systems.30GB needs bounded active profiles and verified offloading;20GB is not yet validated.
hardware.cpu_allocation: dedicated; distinguish physical cores and SMT vCPUs
hardware.software_base: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS; pin all Go/Rust/Python/backend versions before measurements

worker_policy: Canary8 and16 workers where physical cores permit; freeze one common worker/affinity setting for every primary backend. Native BLAS1. Do not infer linear core speedup.
replication_note: Repeated timings within a fit are not independent data/fit replications. Incomplete targets must be disclosed.
baseline_scope: Full Groth16: same backend, exact-cost output stronger than sign-only
PCA certificate: same wrapper, rank, cap and cost-aware scheduling
ZKML Halo2 primitive adapter: adapted task, not unmodified compiler
cache_epoch: X, C0, B, quantization and trust pins fixed. Candidate Ct varies. Rebuild/authenticate and charge new setup whenever the changed model/circuit requires it.
query_generation: Generate and pin up to1024 genuinely distinct candidate banks using training/incoming data only. The existing64-bank pilot cannot be duplicated and called1024 independent requests.
cold_warm: Give every baseline the same applicable setup/data/old-reference reuse. Count recurring process/key loads. Do not combine separate warm/cold runs into a newly measured cold run.
prefix_accounting: One long pass per timing block with fresh request proofs and complete per-request readiness timestamps. Do not infer service-prefix latency from all-moments-first bulk generation.

research_questions.topic: Component roles and centroid-informed versus equal-rank PCA geometry
Verified quality, exact-integer interval validity, refinement cost and tamper rejection
Measured cold/warm cumulative request cost and per-baseline crossover
Catalog/dimension scale, time, memory, keys and fresh versus complete proof bytes
Candidate drift, difficult data and cache/reference lifetime
Cost-aware scheduling applied equally to centroid and PCA certificates

readiness_work_remaining: Interleave and timestamp complete per-request proof/replay work, retaining verifiable completeness
Run current cost-aware policy on the PCA baseline with matched inputs and profiling
Freeze train/validation/audit IDs, independent fits and new candidate streams
Canary each actual backend/shape and build a server-specific runtime/memory ledger
Freeze executable hashes, worker counts, resource caps and paired execution order

resource_phase_plan_hours.scope: Build, pin, smoke, canary and runtime forecast
Primary paired methods, two data sources, Q32/64 and replication targets
Prespecified long-request case; Q256, extend only if all comparators fit
Independent replay, evidence audit, plots and backup

success_reporting: All wins, ties, losses, unfinished and capacity-excluded cells retained. No universal superiority, invented crossover, native-as-ZK timing, or missing-baseline speed ratios.
paired_analysis: Use paired ratios and fit/block-aware dispersion; do not treat correlated requests or timing repeats as independent dataset replications.
public_output_note: Routing and refinement indices are observable. No new assignment privacy claim. Exact-cost and interval/sign output contracts remain explicit.
